entry.en: Your passport must have a date of issue less than 10 years before the date you arrive.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una fecha de emisión de menos de 10 años antes de tu llegada.
entry.quote: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive

entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe caducar al menos 3 meses después del día en que planees salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: On short stays into the Schengen area you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo, at no cost.
entry.es: En estancias cortas en el espacio Schengen puede que debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas y foto, sin coste.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo. There is no cost for EES registration.

entry.en: Switzerland handles customs matters for Liechtenstein and the border between the two countries is open.
entry.es: Suiza se encarga de los asuntos aduaneros de Liechtenstein y la frontera entre ambos países está abierta.
entry.quote: Switzerland handles customs matters for Liechtenstein and there is an open border between the 2 countries.

safety.en: Crime levels are low, but there is some petty street crime, so take precautions against bag-snatching and pickpocketing.
safety.es: La criminalidad es baja, pero hay algo de delincuencia callejera menor, así que toma precauciones contra tirones de bolso y carteristas.
safety.quote: Crime levels are low, but there are instances of petty street crime. Take precautions to avoid bag-snatching and pickpocketing and do not leave your valuables unattended.

safety.en: There is a risk of avalanches in mountainous areas all year round.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de avalanchas en zonas de montaña durante todo el año.
safety.quote: There is a risk of avalanches in mountainous areas all year round.

safety.en: For hiking and mountaineering, do not undertake any activity alone and consider hiring a guide.
safety.es: En senderismo y montañismo, no hagas ninguna actividad solo y considera contratar un guía.
safety.quote: Do not undertake any activity alone and consider hiring a guide.

safety.es: Esquiar fuera de pista es muy peligroso.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, conllevan penas severas.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.

safety.en: Although there is no recent history of terrorism in Liechtenstein, attacks cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: Aunque no hay historial reciente de terrorismo en Liechtenstein, no se pueden descartar ataques.
safety.quote: Although there’s no recent history of terrorism in Liechtenstein, attacks cannot be ruled out.

health.en: Dial 144 or 112 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Marca el 144 o el 112 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Dial 144 or 112 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Liechtenstein you need a GHIC or an EHIC.
health.es: Para recibir atención sanitaria pública médicamente necesaria en Liechtenstein necesitas una tarjeta GHIC o EHIC.
health.quote: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Liechtenstein, you need a Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) or a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC).

health.en: A GHIC or EHIC is not an alternative to travel insurance.
health.es: Una GHIC o EHIC no sustituye al seguro de viaje.
health.quote: A GHIC or EHIC is not an alternative to travel insurance.

health.en: Biting insects and ticks are a health risk between April and October.
health.es: Los insectos que pican y las garrapatas son un riesgo para la salud entre abril y octubre.
health.quote: biting insects and ticks between April and October

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink.
health.es: El agua del grifo es segura para beber.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink.

health.en: You would more likely be transferred to a hospital in Switzerland if you need medical attention.
health.es: Si necesitas atención médica, es más probable que te trasladen a un hospital en Suiza.
health.quote: it is more likely that you would be transferred to a hospital in Switzerland should you require medical attention.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Liechtenstein are 118 for fire, 117 for police and 144 for ambulance.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Liechtenstein son 118 para bomberos, 117 para policía y 144 para ambulancia.

getting_in.en: Liechtenstein has no airports; you can fly to Zürich Airport, 115 km away.
getting_in.es: Liechtenstein no tiene aeropuertos; puedes volar al aeropuerto de Zúrich, a 115 km.
getting_in.quote: Liechtenstein has no airports. You can take a flight to Zürich Airport (ZRH IATA), 115 km from Liechtenstein.

getting_in.en: Flixbus goes to Vaduz from Munich, Bregenz, Lindau, Milan, Lugano and Chur (as of mid-2024).
getting_in.es: Flixbus llega a Vaduz desde Múnich, Bregenz, Lindau, Milán, Lugano y Coira (a mediados de 2024).
getting_in.quote: Flixbus goes to Vaduz from Munich, Bregenz, Lindau, Milan, Lugano and Chur (as of mid-2024).

getting_in.en: Buses run every 15 minutes from Buchs train station to Schaan and Vaduz.
getting_in.es: Hay autobuses cada 15 minutos desde la estación de Buchs hasta Schaan y Vaduz.
getting_in.quote: Buses run every 15 minutes from the train station at Buchs (the main Swiss town on the Liechtenstein border) to Schaan and Vaduz.

getting_in.en: Liechtenstein is the only European country with a rail network and no train station in its capital.
getting_in.es: Liechtenstein es el único país europeo con red ferroviaria sin estación de tren en su capital.
getting_in.quote: Liechtenstein is the only European country with a rail network where there is no train station in the capital city

getting_in.en: There have been no immigration controls since Liechtenstein joined the Schengen Area on 19 December 2011.
getting_in.es: No hay controles de inmigración desde que Liechtenstein se unió al espacio Schengen el 19 de diciembre de 2011.
getting_in.quote: There have been no immigration controls since Liechtenstein joined the Schengen Area on 19 December 2011.

getting_in.en: No border formalities have been needed for crossing between Liechtenstein and Switzerland since 1923.
getting_in.es: No se necesitan trámites fronterizos para cruzar entre Liechtenstein y Suiza desde 1923.
getting_in.quote: Since 1923 there have been no border formalities needed for crossing between the two countries.

getting_around.en: A bus day ticket costs Fr. 12 and a 7-day unlimited card costs Fr. 24 (as of Jan 2024).
getting_around.es: Un billete de día de autobús cuesta 12 Fr. y una tarjeta ilimitada de 7 días 24 Fr. (a enero de 2024).
getting_around.quote: A day ticket costs Fr. 12 (as of Jan 2024) and a 7-day unlimited use card costs Fr. 24.

getting_around.en: Single bus tickets can be bought from the driver or through the FAIRTIQ or SBB Mobile apps.
getting_around.es: Los billetes sencillos de autobús se compran al conductor o con las apps FAIRTIQ o SBB Mobile.
getting_around.quote: Single ride tickets can be purchased from the driver, or through FAIRTIQ or SBB Mobile apps.

getting_around.en: The train is purely a commuter service, with nearly all trains running in the morning and evenings on weekdays.
getting_around.es: El tren es solo un servicio de cercanías, con casi todos los trenes por la mañana y por la tarde en días laborables.
getting_around.quote: The train is purely a commuter service, with nearly all trains running in the morning and evenings on weekdays.

getting_around.en: Roads are in excellent condition and many in the Balzers-Schaan corridor even have bike lanes.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras están en excelente estado y muchas del corredor Balzers-Schaan tienen carril bici.
getting_around.quote: The roads in Liechtenstein are in excellent condition and many (in the Balzers-Schaan corridor) even offer bike lanes.

getting_around.en: Some road sections between cities are 80 km/h, but mostly the limit is 50 km/h.
getting_around.es: Algunos tramos entre ciudades son de 80 km/h, pero sobre todo el límite es de 50 km/h.
getting_around.quote: Some sections of the road between cities are 80 km/h, but primarily within the 50 km/h zone.

money.en: Liechtenstein uses the Swiss franc, and many shops also accept euros but the exchange rate may not be advantageous.
money.es: Liechtenstein usa el franco suizo, y muchas tiendas aceptan también euros, aunque el tipo de cambio puede no ser ventajoso.
money.quote: Liechtenstein uses the Swiss franc (CHF) as its currency since 1924. Many shops will also accept euros, but the exchange rate may not be very advantageous and you will get your change in Euro.

money.en: Costs are roughly equivalent to Switzerland and so somewhat more expensive than in other European countries.
money.es: Los costes son aproximadamente equivalentes a los de Suiza y, por tanto, algo más caros que en otros países europeos.
money.quote: Costs in Liechtenstein are roughly equivalent to those in Switzerland and are therefore somewhat more expensive than other European countries.

etiquette.en: Liechtensteiners are very proud of their national identity and would take offence at being wrongly labelled as German, Austrian or Swiss.
etiquette.es: Los habitantes de Liechtenstein están muy orgullosos de su identidad nacional y se ofenden si los califican erróneamente de alemanes, austriacos o suizos.
etiquette.quote: Liechtensteiners are very proud of their national identity and would take offence at being wrongly labelled

etiquette.en: It is a traditional Catholic country, and on Sundays the streets are almost dead except for tourists and tourist shops.
etiquette.es: Es un país católico tradicional y los domingos las calles están casi vacías salvo por turistas y tiendas turísticas.
etiquette.quote: Remember that this is a traditional Catholic country. On Sundays, the streets are almost dead except for the tourists and the tourist shops.

etiquette.en: The Prince of Liechtenstein and the Monarchy are well respected in Liechtenstein.
etiquette.es: El príncipe de Liechtenstein y la monarquía son muy respetados en el país.
etiquette.quote: The Prince of Liechtenstein and the Monarchy are well respected in Liechtenstein.

connectivity.en: As of Sept 2021, the country has 4G from all Swiss carriers, but 5G has not yet arrived.
connectivity.es: A septiembre de 2021, el país tiene 4G de todos los operadores suizos, pero aún no ha llegado el 5G.
connectivity.quote: As of Sept 2021, the country has 4G from all Swiss carriers, but 5G has not yet arrived.

connectivity.en: Wifi is widely available in public places.
connectivity.es: El wifi está ampliamente disponible en lugares públicos.
connectivity.quote: Wifi is widely available in public places.
